counterexample: The diamond lattice M3 = {0, a, b, c, 1} (with a, b, c pairwise incomparable) is finite, hence a complete lattice, so it is an object of CLat. But a AND (b OR c) = a AND 1 = a, while (a AND b) OR (a AND c) = 0 OR 0 = 0, so M3 fails even finite distributivity and therefore fails the frame law x AND sup(A) = sup{x AND y : y in A}. Hence M3 is not a frame and is not an object of Frm, so the objects of CLat are not a subcollection of the objects of Frm.
reasoning_summary: 0001: Legitimate appeal to the lemma 'Complete Lattice Homomorphism is Frame Homomorphism'; the lemma itself is true (a map between frames preserving all meets and all joins in particular preserves finite meets and arbitrary joins), so citing it is fine. 0002: FAILS - this step asserts two things, that the objects of CLat form a subcollection of the objects of Frm and that the morphisms do, but the cited result is purely morphism-level and says nothing about objects; moreover the object claim is false under the standard definition of a frame (a complete lattice satisfying x AND sup(A) = sup{x AND a}), since non-distributive complete lattices such as M3 are objects of CLat but not of Frm. The morphism claim also cannot even be stated for a complete lattice whose underlying poset is not a frame, since 'frame homomorphism' requires frames as domain and codomain, so the step is unjustified in both halves. 0003: Blank spacing line; nothing to justify. 0004: Appeal to the definitions of the two categories as a setup for the identity/composition conditions; acceptable as a framing move. 0005: Correct - both CLat and Frm are concrete categories whose morphisms are mappings and whose composition is ordinary composition of mappings, so composition agrees on the overlap. 0006: Connective word 'and'; nothing to justify. 0007: Correct - identity morphisms in both categories are the identity mappings on the underlying sets, so identities agree on shared objects (the identity map on a frame is both a complete lattice homomorphism and a frame homomorphism). 0008: Blank spacing line; nothing to justify. 0009: Unsupported - the definition of subcategory requires object inclusion, morphism inclusion, and agreement of composition and identities; 0005 and 0007 supply only the last two, while the object and morphism inclusions rest entirely on the failed step 0002, so the conclusion does not follow. 0010: The qed marker inherits the defect of 0009. 0011-0013: Blank line and ProofWiki category tags; no mathematical content.
